intro: The Workshop Entrance, commonly known as the backdoor to Gnomeregan, is an access portal situated just beyond the Train Depot. It provides seasoned adventurers and engineers an alternative route into the depths of the irradiated city, bypassing the front gates and opening near the Engineering Labs.

p: Located across the cavernous workshop floor just past the Train Depot, the Workshop Entrance offers a direct approach into the industrial heart of Gnomeregan. Flanked on one side by the opening to the Loading Room, this passage cuts straight through to the Engineering Labs, avoiding the fortified entry gates that leper gnomes and troggs contest near the surface. For strike teams attempting to reclaim the underground capital, bypassing the initial perimeter through this side door can prove vital.
